kebab_example: aliyun iacservice create-task --auto-apply false --auto-destroy true --client-token a65451293e64979ba7a4b573950217fe --description this_is_description --group-info groupId=g-5fd38c9b83a86432e2 projectId=p-433aeade5d9167608 --init-module-state false --module-id mod-144fff6b316f4eb737e --module-version v1 --name TaskName --protection-strategy PreventDestroy --ram-role RoleName --skip-property-validation true --skip-region-validation true --terraform-version 1.5.7 --trigger-strategy Manual --task-backend objectPath=/log bucketName=iac-runtime-test bucketEndpoint=ss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com --tags tagValue=TestValue tagKey=TestKey --parameter-set-ids pts-adfadfadf --terraform-provider-version 1.248.0 --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTask

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically execute the task. Default value: false.
true: After the preview is complete (terraform plan), the execution (terraform apply) is automatically performed without manual confirmation.
false: After the preview is complete (terraform plan), manual confirmation is required before the execution (terraform apply) starts
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动执行任务，默认值为false。
true：指的是预览完成（terraform plan）后，无需人工二次确认，自动执行（terraform apply）。
false：指的是预览完成（terraform plan）后，需人工二次确认并开始执行（terraform apply）
parameters.name: auto_apply

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically destroy resources after creation. Default value: false.
true: After the execution is complete (terraform apply), the destroy operation (terraform destroy) is automatically performed without manual confirmation.
false: After the execution is complete (terraform apply), no further action is taken
parameters.help_zh:
是否创建后删除，默认值为false。
true：指的是执行完成（terraform apply）后，无需人工二次确认，自动执行销毁操作（terraform destroy）。
false：指的是执行完成（terraform apply）后，无任何操作
parameters.name: auto_destroy

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. Format: [0-9a-zA-Z-]{1,64}. We recommend that you use a UUID
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use a state file. Default value: false. This parameter applies to templates that originate from resource export. Only one task can use this parameter at a time
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用state文件，默认false，适用于模板为资源导出的来源，限制只能有一个任务使用
parameters.name: init_module_state

parameters.help_en:
The task name. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The name can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.). The name cannot start or end with a hyphen, underscore, or period.
The name must be unique among all tasks under the current account
parameters.help_zh:
任务名称，需满足下述要求：

长度为 2~128 个字符。
允许大小写字母、数字、中文、短横线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.），且不能以短横线、下划线、半角句号开头或结尾。
名称在当前账号的任务资源下唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The collection of associated parameter set IDs
parameters.name: parameter_set_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of resource protection strategies
parameters.name: protection_strategy

parameters.help_en: The RAM role. The system assumes this role to execute the template when a new job is triggered. This parameter is required when the job trigger method is not manual
parameters.help_zh:
RAM角色，
触发新作业时由系统扮演角色来执行模板，
作业触发方式非手动触发时必填
parameters.name: ram_role

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to skip enumeration value validation. Default value: false
parameters.name: skip_property_validation

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to skip region validation. Valid values: true (skip) and false (do not skip)
parameters.help_zh: 是否跳过地域校验。取值：true 表示跳过，false 表示不跳过
parameters.name: skip_region_validation

fields.help_en: The tag key of the task
fields.name: tag_key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the task
fields.name: tag_value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags for the task
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The task configuration. After this parameter is configured, runtime log information is saved to the specified OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh: 任务配置，配置此参数后，运行的日志信息将保存到指定的OSS中
parameters.name: task_backend

parameters.help_en: The Terraform Provider version. You can call the ListTerraformProviderVersions operation to obtain the list of supported versions
parameters.help_zh: Terraform Provider 版本。可通过 ListTerraformProviderVersions 查询支持的版本列表
parameters.name: terraform_provider_version

parameters.help_en: The Terraform version. You can call the ListAvailableTerraformVersions operation to obtain the list of supported versions. Default value: 1.5.7
parameters.help_zh: Terraform版本，通过 ListAvailableTerraformVersions API获取支持的版本列表，默认为1.5.7
parameters.name: terraform_version

parameters.help_en:
The job trigger method. Valid values:

Manual: Manual trigger (default).
NewVersion: Triggered when a new template version is published.
ParameterSetUpdated: Triggered when the parameter set content changes or the parameter set binding relationship changes.
Auto: Automatically triggered when the task's own properties change, such as task creation, execution version change, or job trigger strategy change (when changed from another value to Auto).

The ramRole parameter is required when the trigger method is not manual
parameters.help_zh:
作业触发方式

Manual  ：手动触发（默认）
NewVersion ：模板发布新版本时触发
ParameterSetUpdated 参数集自身参数内容变更或参数集绑定关系变更时       触发
Auto ：当任务自身属性，如新建任务、执行版本或者作业触发策略（由其他改为Auto时），发生变更时自动触发

非手动触发时必填ramRole参数
parameters.name: trigger_strategy
